---
title: 'Not reported — Alternative aggregation rules, static estimator'
format: html
---

```{r}
pacman::p_load(tidyverse, arrow, here, DIDmultiplegtSTAT)

data_majority <- read_parquet(here("data", "data_quarterly_majority.parquet"))
data_all_months <- read_parquet(here("data", "data_quarterly_all_months.parquet"))
```

## Majority rule (2 of 3 months)

### M1: Main specification

```{r}
majority_m1 <- did_multiplegt_stat(
  df = data_majority,
  Y = "n_installations_per_1000",
  ID = "id",
  Time = "time",
  D = "treatment",
  exact_match = TRUE,
  placebo = TRUE
)
print(majority_m1)
```

### M2: Explicit AOSS

```{r}
majority_m2 <- did_multiplegt_stat(
  df = data_majority,
  Y = "n_installations_per_1000",
  ID = "id",
  Time = "time",
  D = "treatment",
  estimator = "aoss",
  exact_match = TRUE,
  placebo = TRUE
)
print(majority_m2)
```

### M3: Explicit WAOSS

```{r}
majority_m3 <- did_multiplegt_stat(
  df = data_majority,
  Y = "n_installations_per_1000",
  ID = "id",
  Time = "time",
  D = "treatment",
  estimator = "waoss",
  exact_match = TRUE,
  placebo = TRUE
)
print(majority_m3)
```

### M4: AOSS and WAOSS

```{r}
majority_m4 <- did_multiplegt_stat(
  df = data_majority,
  Y = "n_installations_per_1000",
  ID = "id",
  Time = "time",
  D = "treatment",
  estimator = c("aoss", "waoss"),
  exact_match = TRUE,
  placebo = TRUE
)
print(majority_m4)
```

### M5: Test AOSS = WAOSS

```{r}
majority_m5 <- did_multiplegt_stat(
  df = data_majority,
  Y = "n_installations_per_1000",
  ID = "id",
  Time = "time",
  D = "treatment",
  estimator = c("aoss", "waoss"),
  exact_match = TRUE,
  aoss_vs_waoss = TRUE,
  placebo = TRUE
)
print(majority_m5)
```

### M6: Switchers up (0 -> 1)

```{r}

  ID = "id",
  Time = "time",
  D = "treatment",
  exact_match = TRUE,
  switchers = "up",
  placebo = TRUE
)
print(majority_m6)
```

### M7: Switchers down (1 -> 0)

